BiblicalUsage: Madduach is seduction, the false burden, and it appears once, in Lamentations 2:14, where the prophets saw vain and foolish things and false burdens and causes of banishment, and never showed the people their iniquity.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a prophet who will not name sin is worse than silent: his soft words are the seduction itself.
